title: Pawn Planet
description:
Welcome to Pawn Planet! Your intergalactic pawn shop adventure! Transform a dusty corner of the cosmos into a thriving business where quirky alien artifacts and cosmic bargains abound. Buy, repair, and sell mysterious treasures to become the galaxy’s top entrepreneur. Ready to hustle among the stars?

 

Make business with customers coming to your shop across the galaxy. 

Sell items. 

Complete missions.

Order repair parts, fix broken items and earn more cash. 

Attend storage auctions. Risk your money to only buy worthless storage or get lucky and find a fortune!
 

Your journey to become a legendary interstellar entrepreneur starts here. Welcome to the hustle of the galaxy, where every deal can either rocket you to fortune or plunge you into cosmic space.
description_short: You're in charge of managing the pawn shop in this weird galaxy. Make deals with strange customers, flip items, attend auctions and keep the shop going!
